word_order: SVO — samples consistently place an overt subject before the verb and objects/complements after the verb (e.g. "Music is often recorded...", "Stardust will set a new...", "Stars give off light...").
register: edited encyclopedic/informational prose (written, relatively formal, fact-reporting; similar to encyclopedia or news-style sentences).
notes_for_prompt_writer: Prefer splitting on full clause signals (subordinators/relative pronouns) but be conservative where PPs or coordinators can attach inside a clause. Avoid treating commas in lists, appositives, abbreviations or titles as reliable clause ends. Watch tokens like 'to', 'that', 'for', 'while' — they frequently start subordinate material or remain part of a phrase and can be overturned by following words.
